description:
Expression of a B. napus gene's A- and C-subgenome homoeologues per tissue/treatment group (Expression Atlas
and BrassicaEDB baseline TPM, Darmor-bzh v4.1 genes), with log2(A/C) and a bias call per group (A dominant,
C dominant or balanced at a 2-fold threshold; groups with A+C TPM < min_tpm are not called), counts per
experiment and the genome-wide share of A-dominant, C-dominant and balanced 1:1 pairs in the same experiment for
comparison. gene: Darmor ID or name (GSBRNA2T00119268001, BnaA09g55580D), a curated symbol or a ZS11 ID. Without
experiment: groups of the experiment with most called groups and counts for the rest; experiment gives one in full.
name: napus_homoeologue_expression
